lines.en: Ayane shows up at the diner a few minutes after I do and greets me with a huge hug.
lines.zh: Ayane 在我到餐厅几分钟后出现，用一个大大的拥抱跟我打招呼。

lines.en: It attracts the attention of a few other customers, but I think most of them just chalk it up to our relationship being familial in nature.
lines.zh: 这吸引了几个别的客人的注意，不过我想他们大多只是把这归为「我们关系是家人性质的」。

lines.en: I doubt anyone would expect a guy my age to be having a romantic meeting with someone like Ayane this early in the morning in front of so many people.
lines.zh: 我怀疑没人会想到，我这个年纪的男人会大清早在这么多人面前，跟 Ayane 这样的人来一场浪漫的会面。

lines.en: But, I mean...I guess this {i}is{/i} sort of a romantic meeting in a sense.
lines.zh: 不过，我是说……我想这在某种意义上也{i}算是{/i}一场浪漫会面。

lines.en: Sure. We're on opposite ends of the table and Ayane is just going on about a dream she had, but it feels like the connection between us is stronger than ever before.
lines.zh: 当然。我们坐在桌子两端，Ayane 只是在讲她做的一个梦，可我感觉我俩之间的联系比以往任何时候都强。

lines.en: It's strange how just doing normal things together can manage to bring people so close.
lines.zh: 奇怪的是，光是一起做些普通的事，就能把人拉得这么近。

lines.en: Ayane says goodbye to me with a hug just as strong as the one she gave me when she arrived.
lines.zh: Ayane 用一个跟来时一样用力的拥抱跟我道别。

lines.en: She presses her face against my chest and closes her eyes, smiling like a girl bidding goodbye to her father on his way to work.
lines.zh: 她把脸贴在我胸口、闭上眼睛，笑得像个送父亲上班的女儿。

lines.en: Of course, that daughterly illusion doesn't last long.
lines.zh: 当然，那种女儿般的错觉没持续多久。

lines.en: It's broken when she whispers into my ear to come see her at night soon before kissing me on the cheek and skipping away.
lines.zh: 它被打破了——她凑到我耳边轻声说「晚上快点来看我」，然后亲了下我的脸颊，蹦蹦跳跳地走了。

lines.en: It's broken when she whispers into my ear to come organize bones with her at night.
lines.zh: 它被打破了——她凑到我耳边轻声说，晚上去跟她一起整理骨头。
